A '''damutek''' existed on the surface of [[Coruscant/Legends|Yuuzhan'tar]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. A disguised [[Nom Anor]] discovered that the [[damutek]] was a secret facility for [[Shaper caste|shapers]] who were trying to fill the empty [[Eighth cortex]].
